SELECT
  week_start_dt,
  dept_id,
  dept_name,
  SUM(week_new_user_num) AS new_user,
  SUM(week_retention_user_num) AS ret_user,
  ROUND(SUM(week_retention_user_num) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(week_new_user_num), 0), 4) AS ret_rate_pct,
  SUM(week_recharge_amt) AS recharge_fen,
  ROUND(AVG(week_avg_dau), 0) AS avg_dau_avg,
  COUNT(*) AS app_rows
FROM ads.ads_product_promotion_summary_w
WHERE week_start_dt IN ('2026-11-09', '2026-11-16', '2026-11-23')
